description: I am a junior in high school and looking for experience in astrophysics and astronomy.
summary: I developed an interactive 3D simulation that showcases a model of the solar system along with NASA rovers and instruments. Each celestial body and instrument has its own information card that gives simple descriptions for younger kids to understand. The interesting feature of my project is that I used real Minecraft block textures and Minecraft GUI features to create a fun, captivating theme for students to explore the forgotten explorers of the solar system. This simulation will emphasize the achievements and discoveries made by NASA's rovers, probes, and satellites to young children, sparking interest in aerospace and the solar system in the next generation.
details:
My project is an interactive 3D Minecraft-themed simulation of the solar system and NASA's forgotten spacecraft. I wanted to focus on capturing the attention of a young audience and inspire them to explore aerospace and astrophysics. Therefore, I used real Minecraft block textures for the Sun, the Moon, and the planets and a Minecraft-style hotbar and first-person view.

For this project, I used the languages HTML, CSS, and Javascript to make this simulation. I utilized the help of the Replit AI Agent to gather legitimate Minecraft block textures and sort through the NSSDC (National Space Science Data Center) data.

In this simulation, the user can click on different spacecraft, planets, the Sun, or the Moon and can view a general information card on them. They can also zoom in and move the object around. Additionally, they can navigate using the bottom Minecraft themed hotbar to look at each spacecraft.

When designing the simulation, I prioritized historical accuracy using NASA's open data as well as catering toward the younger audience through a familiar medium like the game Minecraft.
